en-US.name: bridge demo
en-US.summary: Talks to an MCP server through the alexa-skill-mcp-bridge.
en-US.description: Development Alexa Skill created by alexa-skill-mcp-bridge. It stands in for an Alexa+ add-on: each turn goes to an agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime, which calls the tools of an MCP server and speaks the results.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask bridge demo which park is best for fishing
Alexa, ask bridge demo about Yosemite in June

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Development only. Needs the CDK stack from alexa-skill-mcp-bridge deployed.
